observations: A fresh SciForge chat was started from the left sidebar/main toolbar and submitted through the web composer.
During the successful read-only run, the chat showed a live Working header, a Worked aggregate, an Explored aggregate, and individual Read action rows for a workspace-relative markdown file.
The Read action detail exposed bounded command/file facts and a Preview file control backed by a trusted workspace-relative file ref.
Opening the read action focused the right result pane on the markdown file preview; the pane rendered document content and object controls instead of a raw audit or log dump.

A second read-only diff request produced a Worked aggregate with a Diff action row and expandable action detail; this was recorded as partial diff evidence pending a full expanded diff-detail parity pass.
limitations: Sub-agent transcript/ref expansion was not observed in this SciForge run.
The diff run exposed a Diff action and expandable detail, but this summary does not claim a full side-by-side diff viewer parity pass.
